recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-33008 unless a future work-group decision changes the contained-resource rule itself.
issue_request: FHIR-33008 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core DomainResource and the references page. It requested adding the missing text "or if the contained resource references the container resource" to the first contained-resource bullet so it would no longer contradict the following paragraph and dom-3 invariant.
initial_application: The supporting rule was introduced by FHIR-13187, which changed dom-3 and the contained-resource narrative to allow a contained resource to point to its container. Commit 398042d0fa7b857a589e36db24cdf94960349db2 then applied FHIR-33008 by adding the missing "or if" wording to source/references.html; current blame attributes source/references.html:750 to that commit.
additional_context: source/references.html is an active core references narrative page, and DomainResource is active in source/fhir.ini. The current DomainResource dom-3 human text and expression still allow either a reference to the contained resource or a reference from it to the containing resource. Related contained-reference issues FHIR-12812, FHIR-20340, and FHIR-31582 do not reverse this rule, and the bounded Zulip/Confluence/Jira searches found no later conflicting final decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current contained-resource bullet and the following paragraph both include the container-reference alternative required by FHIR-33008, and the active DomainResource invariant remains consistent with that narrative.
